derivatives_cross_provider.reason: Contract universe, venue coverage, conversion and aggregation methodology are not reconciled.

etf_flow_october_30.interpretation: Small net outflow relative to assets; not proof of immediate spot sales or unhedged demand.

coinbase_q3_2026.circle_equity_exposure: SEC filing references a Coinbase investment in Circle and fair-value remeasurement; amount/share count not separately disclosed.
coinbase_q3_2026.market_share_methodology: Includes stablecoin conversion activity and uses a proprietary competitor set; not comparable to pure spot exchange share.
coinbase_q3_2026.xrp_specific_collateral: No XRP-specific amount disclosed. Product eligibility is not a balance-sheet position.

coinbase_xrp_products.global_exchange_perpetual_margin: XRP is eligible collateral subject to haircuts, concentration limits and liquidation rules.
coinbase_xrp_products.morpho_borrowing: Eligible users can borrow USDC against cbXRP through Morpho using Coinbase's interface.
coinbase_xrp_products.q3_sec_crosscheck: Recognized derivatives collateral table lists BTC and ETH only. The aggregate 'other crypto' recognized lending-collateral bucket is $9.903M; no XRP amount is identified. Unrecognized customer collateral has no token composition.
coinbase_xrp_products.rlusd_listing: Coinbase listed RLUSD across Prime, Exchange and app products on October 28; deposits/withdrawals across XRPL, Base and Ethereum. Ripple provides Base liquidity. Global Exchange collateral support was forthcoming, not live.

coinbase_circle: Coinbase's SEC Q3 filing references an investment in Circle and fair-value remeasurement; position size is not separately disclosed.
Coinbase renewed its USDC arrangement with Circle on the same terms; average USDC held in Coinbase products was about $22B, approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization.
coinbase_ripple: Direct RLUSD distribution/listing relationship across Coinbase Prime, Exchange and app.
Ripple supplies liquidity for RLUSD on Base.
Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support for RLUSD was announced as forthcoming, not live.
circle_ripple: Direct technical collaboration: Circle and Ripple jointly launched native USDC on XRPL in 2025.
USDC and RLUSD are separate issuer liabilities that coexist on XRPL and compete for USD stablecoin distribution/liquidity.
No broader exclusive corporate alliance is established.
ripple_custody_and_regulation: BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform supports XRP and RLUSD; BNY is primary custodian of RLUSD reserves. Token-specific AUC is undisclosed.
Standard Chartered RLUSD custody on XRPL is live; LMAX collateral integration is planned and subject to documentation, testing and approvals.
OCC CAS reports Ripple National Trust Bank Consummated/Effective on 2026-10-26; operational scale remains unverified.
Ripple/Robinhood announced RLUSD channels on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp and institutional settlement use on XRPL; no XRP bridge use is inferred.
sbi_multi_rail: SBI has a direct Circle relationship: Circle SBI Japan JV, approximately $50M strategic investment in Circle, and SBI as an Arc validator.
SBI has a separate direct Ripple relationship through SBI Ripple Asia, XRP distribution and RLUSD Japan channels.
SBI invested approximately $50M in Startale; Startale/SBI develop JPYSC and Strium.
SMFG agreed to a 5% stake in SBI Startale Marketing, the SBI/Startale JV promoting JPYSC.
SBI/Startale joined Open Standard, which includes Coinbase; JPYSC/OUSD interoperability is exploratory, not a bilateral Coinbase-SBI contract.
SBI/Startale/BlackRock signed an MOU to explore tokenized MMFs with JPYSC.

exchange_consolidation: SBI Group completed acquisition of 100% of bitbank on October 1, 2026.
SBI VC Trade absorbed BITPOINT operations on April 1, 2026, while VCTRADE and BITPOINT service environments remain distinct.
SBI VC Trade offers XRP/JPY spot and leverage and lists USDC, RLUSD and JPYSC.
retail_xrp_distribution: SBI Holdings' 2026 shareholder benefit offers JPY2,000 or JPY8,000 equivalent XRP coupons; applications closed October 30 at 17:00 and credits are scheduled mid-to-late November.
SBI Visa Crypto Card rewards can be converted into XRP.
Orico points can be exchanged for XRP credited to SBI VC Trade.
SBI Shinsei and other SBI-group entities have separate XRP reward programs.

jpysc_collateral_and_actual_capital.caveat: JPY6.9B is applications, not confirmed executed loans. Public-chain migration remains conditional.

regulatory.payment_services_act: SBI reports JPY10B of JPYSC trust assets allocated to short-term Japanese government bills within the amended trust-based stablecoin framework.
regulatory.fiea_amendment: Passed July 15 and promulgated July 23, 2026; general commencement is within one year by Cabinet Order.
regulatory.xrp_classification: No official asset-specific classification located. Treating XRP as a non-specified cryptoasset is an inference, not a formal determination.

sbi_japan.sbi_strategy_conclusion: SBI is building multi-issuer, multi-chain infrastructure. XRP is important, but JPYSC, RLUSD, USDC, Strium, tokenized MMFs and OUSD show that the strategy is not XRP-exclusive.

sbic_resolution.primary_entity: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan)
sbic_resolution.distinct_from: SBI Holdings and the SBI Group
sbic_resolution.chatgpt_context: SBIC East Japan's June 12–13, 2025 training curriculum explicitly includes ChatGPT usage and Copilot training for investee companies; educational event, not OpenAI partnership.
sbic_resolution.xrp_relationship: No verified direct relationship with XRP, Ripple, Coinbase or Circle.

ask_coin.coinbase_relationship: Coinbase Embedded Wallet infrastructure is used by ASK Wallet; this is not a Coinbase Exchange listing or investment.
ask_coin.interpretation: Extremely thin reported liquidity and material aggregator supply discrepancy; bridge migration requires issuer-level reconciliation.

actual_capital.operational_definition: Net external capital requires executed, de-duplicated flows with issuer mint/redemption, exchange/custody movements, roundtrips and beneficial-owner changes separated.
actual_capital.phrase_origin: Unresolved. A 1960 U.S. Congressional Record uses 'Total actual capital' for the separate U.S. SBA Small Business Investment Company program; this does not identify the user's original context or connect to XRP.

camilla_stephenson.disambiguation: Dr Kamilah Stevenson and similarly named individuals are not assumed to be Camilla Stephenson.

prediction_engine.next_stage: Immutable point-in-time features, fixed-horizon outcomes, source-registry validation, leakage-safe walk-forward backtests, benchmark comparisons, calibration, drift detection and paper/shadow evaluation.
